items.computation: Period is 30 days after the invoice date (14.04.2026). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (14.04.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 15.04.2026. 30 days later is Thursday 14.05.2026 (§ 188 BGB). 14.05.2026 is Christi Himmelfahrt, a public holiday in NW, so under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Friday 15.05.2026.
